name: check_room
description: Check whether a Smart Campus study room is available for a requested interval in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440) against acceptance criteria AC1-AC6. Returns Available or Unavailable and does not save or modify any booking.

start.description: Requested booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440, e.g. 10:00 = 600).

end.description: Requested booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440, e.g. 24:00 = 1440).

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

blocked.description: Whether the room is currently blocked for maintenance or other reasons.

bookings.description: Existing bookings for the room as a list of {start, end} minute intervals; may be empty.

start.description: Existing booking start time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).

end.description: Existing booking end time in whole minutes since midnight (0 to 1440).
